slides.title: Anthropic is putting *$100M* into one job title.

slides.label: 01 · The news
slides.title: to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers by the end of 2027.
slides.body: Anthropic launched Claude Frontier Academy on 2 October. The first badges are expected in early 2027.

slides.label: 02 · Who's in
slides.title: Big consultancies and banks went first.
slides.body: Accenture, Bain, Capgemini, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Deloitte, McKinsey, Morgan Stanley and Novo Nordisk are in the first cohorts. CommBank is sending an initial group of 20 engineers.
